profile.headline: Sr Software Engineer, Ex-MSFT
profile.summary:
Programming is my life, and I've gone from a hobbyist game developer tinkering with raw hexadecimal and injecting MIPS assembly code to writing mission-critical code for a top public safety company, to Microsoft developer working on the backbone services for $90B+ of transactions, to jumping across the stack in a unicorn with $1B valuation. I still spend my spare time running local LLMs on bleeding edge software and hardware, developing algorithms, and learning new tech because I love it.

Developing software that delights people is one of the greatest feelings in the world. I live for those moments when someone uses a tool or service I've made, turns to me, and says, "This is so cool!", or "This is so much easier!"

positions.title: Caregiving
positions.description:
Moved home to spend time with ailing father, support family. 
Independent coursework/projects in AI, ML, Cloud.

EARNED CREDENTIALS
 - IBM AI FUNDAMENTALS
 - IBM CLOUD COMPUTING

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Development and support of modern services, APIs, and tools.

positions.title: Software Engineer Technical Lead
positions.description:
Provided technical leadership for development of major features for enterprise web-based public safety records management system (Inform RMS) and associated integrations.  Mentored junior and new developers in the technical implementation of major and minor features, as well as bug fixes.

•	Technical lead for redesign of C# state reporting system.

•	Technical lead for electronic submission architecture, using new National Information Exchange Model. Utilized a combination of C# and Python microservices triggered by RabbitMQ messaging
positions.insights: Entity Framework, System Architecture and +12 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed major features for enterprise web-based public safety records management system (Inform RMS) and associated integrations.

•	Developed NUnit test generation tool in spare time, cut minimum bug turnaround time for our team from  between 1-3 hours to 15-30 minutes.

•	Developed TypeScript / AngularJS / HTML / LESS front-end for advanced search feature using ElasticSearch.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed custom integrations and data conversions into Inform RMS for third-party hardware and software.

•	Developed 19 custom integrations solo – worked directly with client agencies to gather requirements, perform Functional Acceptance Testing, sign-off, and further support.

•	Developed REST API endpoint for first major module, including self-documenting Swagger page, versioning, and backwards compatibility strategy.

•	Redesigned and enhanced visual scripting mapping tool to generate XSLT transforms for XML imports, cut mapping time from 2 weeks to 2 days for standard importer.

•	Enhanced existing integration framework to support new web-based RMS.
